approved.fact: DigiGuru turns marketing attention into business action.
DigiGuru connects ads, websites and WhatsApp into a customer journey and builds a conversation layer around the business.
The conversation layer can be designed around business information such as products, services, offers, FAQs, policies and availability.
The wider journey can connect conversations to actions such as bookings, orders, enquiries, quotes, calendars, CRM records, catalogues and human handoffs.
